description: Free, no key. Check a public MCP server by what an agent reads first: does it answer initialize and tools/list without a key, a current protocol version, instructions, a description for every tool, a type and a description for every parameter, a guide at /llms.txt. Returns a score of 100, a grade A to F, and for each missing point how to fix it. For your own server or your principal's; nothing of it is stored. PazAIr's own list, not a certificate or a security audit.

url.description: The https address of the MCP endpoint, e.g. https://example.com/mcp. Public host names only.

name: check_my_agent
